title: Home Adaptation Grant — who can apply
text: The Home Adaptation Grant is available to residents of the Borough who own their home or rent privately with the landlord's written consent. The applicant, or a permanent member of their household, must have an assessed mobility need recorded by the Borough's occupational therapy service. Applications from tenants of Borough-managed housing are handled under the separate Adaptations for Council Tenants scheme and should not be submitted through this route.

title: Home Adaptation Grant — what it covers and limits
text: The grant covers stairlifts, level-access showers, ramped access, widened doorways and ground-floor toilet installation. The maximum award is 12,000 per property in any rolling five-year period. Where an occupational therapy assessment recommends works costing more than the maximum, the Borough may agree a phased programme across two award periods. Decorative works, general repairs and garden alterations are not covered.

title: Home Adaptation Grant — how decisions are made
text: Complete applications are assessed within 20 working days of receipt. Incomplete applications are returned and the 20-day period restarts when the missing information arrives. Applicants are notified of the decision in writing. An applicant who disagrees with a decision may request a review within 28 days of the notification date; reviews are conducted by an officer who was not involved in the original decision.

title: Home Adaptation Grant — contribution and means test
text: Applicants in receipt of a qualifying income-related benefit pay no contribution. All other applicants complete a means assessment, and any contribution is capped at 20% of the assessed cost of works. The means assessment considers household income and capital above 6,000. Contributions are payable to the contractor on completion, not to the Borough.
